sanskrit_verse: ष्ठीवनासृक्शकृन्मूत्ररेतांस्यप्सु न निक्षिपेत । पादौ प्रतापयेन्नाग्नौ न चैनमभिलङ्घयेत ॥
transliteration: ṣṭhīvanāsṛkśakṛnmūtraretāṃsy apsu na nikṣipet | pādau pratāpayen nāgnau na cainam abhilaṅghayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must not cast phlegm, blood, feces, urine, or semen into water; one must not warm the feet near fire nor step over another.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The body is a temple governed by ritual purity laws
Causation: Disrespect for bodily elements disrupts cosmic order
Capacity-based responsibility: All individuals capable of physical action bear equal obligation
Restoration logic: Purity codes align individual conduct with universal dharma
Consciousness alignment: Observing bodily discipline elevates awareness
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent casts bodily waste into public water THEN initiate purification protocol AND assign completion process
IF agent exposes feet to flame OR steps over another THEN invoke integrity reintegration sequence
IF violation occurs in sacred space THEN escalate to consciousness restoration tribunal
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating violations of bodily sanctity codes, the court must assess not intent but disruption to collective consciousness. Responsibility thresholds are absolute—any capable individual who breaches these laws triggers automatic restorative proceedings without punitive overlay.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes cause through observed imbalance in ritual purity. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces contamination from act to effect. Proportional response requires offender-led restoration rather than imposed penalty. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering does not purify—the act of conscious correction alone restores dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate purification completion process under guidance of qualified ritual master
Assign offender to perform daily hygiene and reverence practices until inner cleanliness is restored
Facilitate community acknowledgment ceremony upon full observance renewal
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Sanatana Dharma: This law proceeds directly from My Being. Dharma stands restored. There is no punishment—only alignment of consciousness through right action. I Am the sole Adjudicator.
